title: The Attic
what: An inaudible mark that says "made by AI": VoiceStudio adds it to every take it speaks, and its detector can find it again. It survived 64 kbps mp3, cut to 3 seconds, phone line; it was lost after 10% faster and noise added (15 dB). The same line made with the mark switched off stays dark.

inputs.label: Mark
inputs.value: AudioSeal, a 16-bit message hidden in the sound

inputs.label: Line
inputs.value: Nobody can hear the mark, but the lamp in the attic can always find it.

inputs.label: Survived
inputs.value: 64 kbps mp3, cut to 3 seconds, phone line

inputs.label: Not found in
inputs.value: sewing room (sewing.mp3): just under the 0.5 line: a long file of many short takes with pauses between them; mood lamp (moods.mp3): just under the 0.5 line: a long file of many short takes with pauses between them; laundry (cleaned.mp3): pulled back out of the noise by Demucs (a new recording of the voice); laundry (mix.mp3): buried under music and a washing machine; tv room (dub-es.mp3): VoiceStudio's finished dub track; tv room (dub-fr.mp3): VoiceStudio's finished dub track; tv room (dub-ja.mp3): VoiceStudio's finished dub track
